fluff.overview: The Free Worlds League's fractious politics have always made centralized BattleMech procurement difficult, pushing the FWLM toward heavy investment in conventional infantry to fill the gaps. Jump infantry in League service exploit vertical mobility to compensate for the FWLM's sometimes fragmented command structure, seizing terrain that wheeled or tracked forces cannot reach. Their ability to operate across broken ground and urban environments makes them valuable in the border provinces where coalition territory changes hands frequently. Equipped with laser rifles that offer superior range and armor penetration compared to ballistic weapons, these platoons field one of the most effective personal arms available to conventional infantry, though the weapons are significantly more expensive and require soldiers to carry additional power packs.
